description: Check what each side says was delivered for a payment: the hash the gate filed for what it served, and the hash the agent filed for what it received. Use it to confirm a purchase arrived intact, or to show a discrepancy. Read-only and free. Note it records WHICH bytes were delivered, not whether their contents were correct.

payment_id.description: The payment id returned by gate_fetch. Only payments settled through an escrow have one; prepaid and subscription access do not.

name: gate_check_delivery
